name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 28 – Am 71
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 28a. Is convinced that there is no military solution to the conflict and that peace is the only viable and lasting response; strongly supports the efforts undertaken by the United States, Ukraine and Russia to pursue diplomatic avenues towards reaching a lasting peace agreement;
